description: This PHP source file defines the EmailsViewDetailDraft class, which inherits from ViewDetail. It is responsible for handling the display logic for email draft details within the SuiteCRM module. The class initializes certain properties, loads metadata, and sets up the detail view for email drafts.

classes.name: EmailsViewDetailDraft
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail that manages the display of email draft details in the SuiteCRM email module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that sets the type to 'DetailDraft' and enables subpanels, then calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Pre-display hook that retrieves metadata, initializes the EmailsDraftDetailView, populates it with request data, and sets it up with module info and focus object.
